how_to_apply: Eligible candidates can apply online for ERD Punjab PTI Recruitment 2026 by following the steps below.
Click on "New Registration" and complete the one-time registration with the required details.
Log in to your account using the registration number and password generated after registration.
Click on the "Application Fee" link and pay the applicable fee online.
Fill in the online application form completely and upload the required photograph and signature as per the specified format.
Review the application, submit it, and download/print a copy of the confirmed application form for your records.

Candidates can apply for only one category at a time. If a candidate applies for more than one category, only the first registration/application will be considered valid, and any subsequent registrations/applications will not be considered. A one-time correction facility is available after initial submission of the application; no changes will be permitted after this correction window closes. Candidates should not send any documents by post, as no physical documents are required to be submitted to the office unless specifically asked for during document verification.
important_instructions: The reservation benefit for SC, BC, and other reserved categories is applicable only to bonafide residents of Punjab. Candidates must select their claimed category carefully at the time of application, as no change of category will be permitted after submission. Candidates from a category outside the general merit list who apply online in the general category will not be permitted to switch back to their reserved category later. The EWS certificate must be valid for the financial year 2025-26, applicable for the admission/recruitment year 2026-27. PWD candidates will be given relaxations as per applicable norms, and the relevant category/type-linked certificate must be submitted at the time of document verification. No fee refund or concession will be given to any candidate other than ex-servicemen, under any circumstances. The Director, Education Recruitment Directorate, Punjab, reserves the right to postpone, amend, or cancel this recruitment notification at any stage without prior notice, and candidates will not be entitled to any compensation in such a case. Candidates are advised to regularly check the official website erd.punjab.gov.in for the latest updates related to this recruitment.

content_sections.heading: ERD Punjab PTI Recruitment 2026 Notification Out
content_sections.text: The Education Recruitment Directorate (ERD), Punjab has released the ERD Punjab PTI Recruitment 2026 Notification for 2000 Physical Training Instructor (PTI) posts under the Primary Cadre in the School Education Department, Punjab. The recruitment notification was issued on 31 July 2026 based on memo no. 1/2026869727/1 dated 19-06-2026 by the Director of School Education (Elementary), Punjab. content_sections.heading: ERD Punjab PTI Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: As per Appendix 'B' of the Punjab State Elementary Education (Physical Training Instructor) Service Rules, 2023 (as amended in 2025), candidates must have passed 10+2 along with at least a two-year diploma or certificate in Physical Education, referred to as Diploma in Physical Education or Certificate in Physical Education (D.P.Ed/C.P.Ed) or an equivalent course under any other nomenclature. Candidates who are in the final year of their D.P.Ed/C.P.Ed diploma or certificate course are also eligible to apply, provided they successfully complete and pass the diploma/certificate before the final recruitment merit list date (the deadline for this is the final recruitment merit list date, not the last date of this recruitment process). Additionally, as per Punjab Government notification G.S.R.72/Const./Art.309/Amd.(22)/2022 dated 28-10-2022, candidates must have passed Matriculation with Punjabi as a compulsory or elective subject, or an equivalent examination in Punjabi. Candidates who have not studied Punjabi at the Matric level must clear a qualifying Punjabi language test with a minimum of 50% marks; failing this will disqualify the candidate from the final merit list irrespective of their score in the main written test. The age limit for ERD Punjab PTI Recruitment 2026 is calculated as on 01-01-2025, with relaxations available for specific categories. The Physical Eligibility Test is qualifying in nature and comprises five components. A candidate must successfully clear at least three of the five components to qualify. Differently-abled candidates are exempted from the PET as per the notification. The PET will be conducted by the recruiting agency or the Education Recruitment Directorate, and its applicability and conditions for persons with disability will follow the instructions of the Department of Social Security, Women and Child Development, Government of Punjab.

content_sections.text: Selected candidates will be engaged on a fixed pay scale as per the Punjab State Elementary Education (Physical Training Instructor) Service Rules, 2023, and its First Amendment Rules, 2025.

content_sections.heading: ERD Punjab PTI Application Fee
content_sections.text: The application fee for ERD Punjab PTI Recruitment 2026 differs by category and must be paid online during the application process. Fee relaxation for ex-servicemen is applicable only if the candidate's post-retirement employment with the Central Government or its undertakings has been completed, or the candidate was not discharged from service on disciplinary grounds. Ex-servicemen and their dependents must submit the applicable relaxation certificate, including a Lineal Descendent Certificate (LDC) for dependents, at the time of document verification. No fee refund will be given, even in case of a wrong claim of category-based fee concession, and candidates found to have made an incorrect claim will be blacklisted from all recruitments conducted by the Director, Education Recruitment Directorate, Punjab for three years.

content_sections.heading: ERD Punjab PTI Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection for the PTI (Primary Cadre) posts will be based on a combined merit prepared from a written test and sports achievement weightage, as per the following distribution out of a total of 100 marks. The written test will be a single objective multiple-choice paper of 70 marks conducted at the state level. Candidates must also clear the Physical Eligibility Test (PET), which is qualifying in nature and does not carry marks in the merit calculation. Sports achievement weightage does not apply to candidates recruited under the sports quota; for these candidates, the Punjab Sportsmen Recruitment Rules, 1988, remain applicable. In case of multiple gradation certificates, a candidate can claim weightage for only one gradation certificate issued as per the revised Gradation Policy, 2023, of the Department of Sports and Youth Affairs, Punjab. As per Punjab Government notification dated 28-10-2022, candidates must also clear a qualifying Punjabi language paper with a minimum of 50% marks at the Matriculation standard, in addition to the competitive written test. If two or more candidates score the same marks in the written test, the older candidate will be given preference in merit; if age is also the same, the candidate with a higher percentage of marks in their professional/educational qualification will be preferred.

content_sections.heading: ERD Punjab PTI Required Documents
content_sections.text: Candidates should keep the following documents ready for the online application and subsequent document verification: 10+2 (Matriculation/equivalent) certificate showing Punjabi as a subject, or Punjabi qualifying test certificate D.P.Ed/C.P.Ed diploma or certificate in Physical Education Category certificate (SC/BC/EWS), issued by the competent authority, where applicable Ex-serviceman certificate or Lineal Descendent Certificate (LDC), where applicable Disability certificate (for Physically Handicapped category), issued within the validity period and by an authorized medical board, showing a minimum disability of 40% Sports gradation certificate, where a candidate is claiming sports achievement weightage or applying under the sports quota (recognized only by Sports Punjab) Recent passport-size photograph (2.5 x 3.5 inches, 80% of face visible including ears) and postcard-size photograph (4x6 inches, 80% of face visible, plain background, no cap or goggles) Scanned signature Valid mobile number, email ID, and bank account details (account number, IFSC, bank name)

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for ERD Punjab PTI Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Eligible candidates can apply online for ERD Punjab PTI Recruitment 2026 by following the steps below. Visit the official website: erd.punjab.gov.in Click on "New Registration" and complete the one-time registration with the required details. Log in to your account using the registration number and password generated after registration. Click on the "Application Fee" link and pay the applicable fee online. Fill in the online application form completely and upload the required photograph and signature as per the specified format. Review the application, submit it, and download/print a copy of the confirmed application form for your records. Candidates can apply for only one category at a time. If a candidate applies for more than one category, only the first registration/application will be considered valid, and any subsequent registrations/applications will not be considered. A one-time correction facility is available after initial submission of the application; no changes will be permitted after this correction window closes. Candidates should not send any documents by post, as no physical documents are required to be submitted to the office unless specifically asked for during document verification.

content_sections.heading: ERD Punjab PTI Important Instructions
content_sections.text: The reservation benefit for SC, BC, and other reserved categories is applicable only to bonafide residents of Punjab. Candidates must select their claimed category carefully at the time of application, as no change of category will be permitted after submission. Candidates from a category outside the general merit list who apply online in the general category will not be permitted to switch back to their reserved category later. The EWS certificate must be valid for the financial year 2025-26, applicable for the admission/recruitment year 2026-27. PWD candidates will be given relaxations as per applicable norms, and the relevant category/type-linked certificate must be submitted at the time of document verification. No fee refund or concession will be given to any candidate other than ex-servicemen, under any circumstances. The Director, Education Recruitment Directorate, Punjab, reserves the right to postpone, amend, or cancel this recruitment notification at any stage without prior notice, and candidates will not be entitled to any compensation in such a case. Candidates are advised to regularly check the official website erd.punjab.gov.in for the latest updates related to this recruitment.

faq.question: Q1. What is ERD Punjab PTI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a recruitment drive by the Education Recruitment Directorate (ERD), Punjab, to fill 2000 Physical Training Instructor (PTI) posts under the Primary Cadre in the School Education Department, Punjab.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available under ERD Punjab PTI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 2000 vacancies are available, out of which 650 posts are reserved for women candidates.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for ERD Punjab PTI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to apply online is 31-08-2026. Online applications began on 01-08-2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for ERD Punjab PTI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed 10+2 along with at least a two-year diploma or certificate in Physical Education (D.P.Ed/C.P.Ed) or an equivalent course, along with Punjabi at the Matriculation level or a qualifying Punjabi test with 50% marks.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for ERD Punjab PTI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The general age limit is 18 to 37 years as on 01-01-2025, with relaxations available for SC/BC candidates, government employees, widows/divorced women, and disabled persons of Punjab as per the notification.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for ERD Punjab PTI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application fee is Rs. 2000/- for General and other categories, Rs. 1000/- for SC/BC candidates, and no fee for ex-servicemen.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply online for ERD Punjab PTI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates can apply online through erd.punjab.gov.in by completing new registration, filling the application form, paying the fee, and submitting the form before the last date.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for ERD Punjab PTI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Selection is based on a 70-mark objective written test, a qualifying Physical Eligibility Test (PET), and up to 30 marks for sports achievement gradation, combined into a final merit list of 100 marks.

faq.question: Q9. What is the salary for ERD Punjab PTI posts?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a fixed monthly pay of Rs. 29,200/- (without allowances) during a probation period of 3 years.
